source_checks: mb_hostaim.h enum declares CAMPAIGN_STEP_LOOKUP_VIEW_WEAPON=1. wn_move.c copies lookup to answer, fills r=&answer.f[6], and places the view answer at r[0]. Thus Lua array index7 is the FIRST result word r0, at zero-based event f[6], not a new float metadata field. module.rs aim_event_table sends kind/a/b/c/d plus all12 f words, and main.rs step_events reads that schema.

On armed mode=weapon_step only, the delegate scans the supplied answers and copies every changed kind1 event and all12 f values, setting f[7]=1. It copies the top-level request when a change is made; all other actual protocol fields, events and modes are passed unchanged to base host.aim. It does not mutate the caller table or add a second physical solver.

The configured view value is an exact representable input to the unchanged host precision rule. It is explicitly diagnostic configuration, not a measured camera/player condition. It is not an entity-MISS override, a manufactured TREE question, or a patched campaign precision rule.

The view input is global to all armed weapon steps because the protocol supplies no per-weapon identity. Natural/foreign war activity is declared affected and remains visible. Healthy control means unmodified TREE provider UNDER configured-view context, not wholly unmodified host input. Hosted and Original profiles apply the same input.

Restored simple first ballistic launcher/nearest-enemy selection is read-only until the same previously reviewed real launch/target-link operation. No placements, constructors, package overrides or production weapon rules change.

Normal verdict requires view application and a real precision_high delta before actual contact_trees_tests/provider equality. No step answer or no precision or no TREE call remains UNREACHED. Named fatal refusal still has no postpoison query; view application is observed before the fatal, and no unavailable precision counter is invented afterwards.
